p8_b0.ocr: In the context of evaluating the effects of various treatments on biological responses, the data presented in the accompanying table offers a comprehensive overview of the relationship between dosage and the resultant inhibition of writhing responses. The table categorizes different groups based on the administered doses (mg/kg), highlighting the correlation between increasing doses and the corresponding number of writhing responses observed.

p8_b1.ocr: For instance, the control group, receiving 1% Tween 80 in water at a dose of 10 mL/kg, exhibited an average of 8.8 ± 0.374 writhing responses, underscoring the baseline activity against which other treatments can be measured.
